items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Neutral gray scale (light and dark), shadcn's color names on it, type scale, menu animation. Import after Tailwind.

items.name: use-theme
items.title: useTheme
items.description: System, light or dark, kept in localStorage and applied as <html data-theme>. Includes the first-paint script.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A floating panel from a trigger: 12px corners, 36px rows, grows from the trigger. No positioning library.

items.name: account-menu
items.title: Account menu
items.description: Avatar button and menu: name and email, a system/light/dark switch, your links, log out.

items.name: page
items.title: Page
items.description: PageHeader, Section, List (rounded rows), Notice, and ago() for relative times.

items.name: copy
items.title: Copy
items.description: CopyButton and CopyField (a monospace value with a copy button).

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented
items.description: Two or three choices in one small pill.

items.name: app-header
items.title: App header
items.description: Dashboard top bar: brand, pill navigation, and a slot for the account menu.

items.name: sidebar-layout
items.title: Sidebar layout
items.description: Dashboard with a sidebar: drill-in groups and route layers that slide in with a back row, a top bar with a scope switcher and breadcrumbs, a drawer on phones.

items.name: auth-page
items.title: Sign-in page
items.description: Centered 384px column, 30px title, stacked 40px pill choices, code field, 'Signing in to <app>'.
